linesEn: Ugh, that felt horrible...
Wait, is this the enemy's stronghold?

linesEn: Right as the teleportation magic took effect,
I sensed an overwhelming magical force interfering with it.
The spell's destination was thrown completely into chaos...

linesZhTw: 錯亂…希爾法，我說得沒錯
linesZhCn: 错乱…希尔法，我说得没错
linesEn: ...Isn't that right, Sylpha?

裏去就該慶幸不已了。不過

How on earth did they get here without us even noticing?
What? Are they enemies?

Oh my, looks like someone beat us here!

linesEn: May I ask what brings all of you so far

Are you here to investigate the ancient relics, just as we are?

What did you say? How do you know my name?

linesZhCn: 小时候你经常带我出去玩，

Directive: Protect the Flying Rock. Engage and eliminate all intruders.

There's no time to explain. Ready your weapons!
Nothing gets my blood pumping like a good fight!
Let's take them down!

How could I... fall... at a time like this...?
Damn it... Not before I uncover... the secret of these ruins...

Truly? What an extraordinary coincidence!

linesZhCn: 武士加入，这对我们的战力

linesZhTw: 的戰技一直都是沒話說的！

linesZhCn: 『将军你都可以跷班来考古了
